title: 剑柄打击
author: Kingdom Come Combat
first_page: 输入：刺、刺、右。两次直刺后，以右斩收尾，用剑柄撞击对手面部。
second_page: 剑柄打击不是针对不喜欢穿戴护面甲敌人的首选。在敌人被两次刺击钉住时，把长剑变成近身的铁锤。翻到这里，你已经开始练习剑柄打击。

en_us.title: Pommel Strike
en_us.first_page: Input: Thrust, Thrust, Right. Pin the opponent with two thrusts, then finish from the right and drive the pommel into the face.
en_us.second_page: Once two thrusts have fixed the enemy in place, turn the longsword into a close-range hammer.
